paper_metadata.title: Robustness of quantum algorithms against approximate data representations

summary: The paper studies robustness of gate-based quantum algorithms to approximate amplitude encoding, using Grover search, amplitude estimation/phase-estimation routines, and QFT as benchmarks. It reports that amplitude encoding depth can be compressed by at least 2x with less than 0.01% loss in final-state fidelity for generic small-qubit cases, and up to 5x compression with under 5% infidelity; for input states above 95% fidelity, the downstream algorithms do not significantly amplify the error, and QFT can self-correct some approximation errors.
